job.job_description:
Job Summary




We are looking for a passionate and enthusiastic AI professional with an educational background in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or Computer Science. The ideal candidate should have hands-on exposure to AI tools and technologies and be eager to explore innovative AI-driven solutions to improve business processes and productivity.




Key Responsibilities

Utilize AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, and other AI platforms to support business operations.
Assist in developing AI-based solutions and automation workflows.
Perform prompt engineering to generate accurate and efficient AI outputs.
Research emerging AI technologies and recommend relevant use cases.
Support the implementation of Generative AI solutions across departments.
Analyze data and assist in preparing AI-driven insights and reports.
Participate in chatbot development, AI agents, and workflow automation projects.
Create documentation, user guides, and presentations related to AI initiatives.
Work with technical and business teams to identify opportunities for AI adoption.
Ensure responsible and ethical use of AI technologies.



Educational Qualification

Bachelor's Degree in:
Artificial Intelligence
Computer Science
Data Science
Information Technology
Machine Learning
Related Engineering Discipline



Experience

Freshers or candidates with up to 1 year of experience.
Internship or academic project experience in AI/ML will be an added advantage.



Required Skills

Basic understanding of:
Artificial Intelligence
Machine Learning
Generative AI
Natural Language Processing (NLP)
Prompt Engineering
Familiarity with AI tools such as:
ChatGPT
Microsoft Copilot
Gemini
Claude
Perplexity
Basic knowledge of Python programming.
Understanding of data analytics and visualization concepts.
Familiarity with Microsoft Office 365 tools.
Good problem-solving and analytical skills.



Preferred Skills

Exposure to Power Automate, Power Apps, or RPA tools.
Knowledge of Azure AI, OpenAI, or cloud-based AI services.
Experience with academic AI projects, hackathons, or certifications.
Understanding of AI ethics and responsible AI practices.



Key Competencies

Strong learning aptitude
Curiosity about emerging technologies
Critical thinking
Communication and presentation skills
Teamwork and collaboration
Innovation mindset
